text_block_list.text: After finishing training, while I was cooling down with Marvelous Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's Kitasan! ...Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, you seem down. Is something wrong?
Your eyebrows are all furrowed, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Marvelous-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm just not feeling at my best.
Like my heart's not really into training.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so training just doesn't feel fun to you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It kind of felt like we were stuck in a rut.
...Wait, that means I'm slacking off way too much!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Then come train with me for a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Together?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Wanna run together? Cheer them on?
Or maybe go marvelous-hunting?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Why don't we just do all of it!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, that sounds fun...! But
are you sure you want to hang out with me?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Double the fun, half the pain with two of us☆
Both you and I can become marvelous, Kitasan☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
I can train with Kitasan, right?
choice_data_list: Any more training than this is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay~! Full throttle ahead☆
Let's go all out★ Vroom, vroom, vroooom~~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please push me to the limit today!

Marvelous Sunday began
training together with Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Au...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about it!
I was just happy you invited me in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Plus, talking with Marvelous-san really cheered me up!
I'm gonna try my best in my own way a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... Instead, I'll be cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hooray☆ Hooray★ Kitasan!
Marvelous☆ Marvelous★ Kitasan!!
